say:5:1511103003:0.text: I think it's time we satisfied our curiosity.
say:5:1511103003:0.source_cn: 为什么期待狩猎神陨落，现在可以说了？

say:6:1511103004:0.text: We all got rid of the goddess as promised. So why did you hate her so much?
say:6:1511103004:0.source_cn: 坦诚点，我们都如约弑神了。

say:7:1511103005:0.text: ... It was the <style="highlight">Bloodhunt Festival</style>. The trial where warriors were chosen for the goddess.

say:8:1511103006:0.text: At every festival, all but the final winner were slain by the Hunting Goddess.
say:8:1511103006:0.source_cn: 每一次猎血节，除了最终的胜者，其他人都是狩猎神所杀。

choice_prompt:10:1511103006.text: At every festival, all but the final winner were slain by the Hunting Goddess.
choice_prompt:10:1511103006.source_cn: 每一次猎血节，除了最终的胜者，其他人都是狩猎神所杀。

say:11:1511103007:0.text: Not with her own hands. She just summoned wave after wave of beasts... and let them rip the warriors apart.
say:11:1511103007:0.source_cn: 不是被她亲手所杀。她只是召唤来无数的野兽……把战士全都...

say:12:1511103008:0.text: She bathed in blood for her own pleasure—just to prove she was the superior hunter. She never cared what happened to those who worshiped her.
say:12:1511103008:0.source_cn: 她用鲜血取悦自己……为了证明她是比我们更好的猎手，全然...

say:14:1511103009:0.text: But... Modra always said the festival was a great honor.
say:14:1511103009:0.source_cn: 但是……蒙多分明说，猎血节是一种荣耀。

say:15:1511103010:0.text: All who entered died. How could Modra know otherwise?
say:15:1511103010:0.source_cn: 参加猎血节的战士都死光了，她怎么可能知道。

choice_prompt:17:1511103010.text: All who entered died. How could Modra know otherwise?
choice_prompt:17:1511103010.source_cn: 参加猎血节的战士都死光了，她怎么可能知道。

say:18:1511103011:0.text: I wasn't alone in hating her. I'm just the only one who survived.
say:18:1511103011:0.source_cn: 恨她的不止我一个，但活下来的就我一个。

say:19:1511103012:0.text: And you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, even if I don't like you much, you're still far better than the real Hunting Goddess.
